Let me analyze the conflict:

Register: "Mettler-Toledo (Changzhou) Precision Instruments Ltd."
Document: "Mettler-Toledo (Changzhou) Precision Instrument Ltd."

Difference: "Instruments" vs "Instrument" — singular vs plural. This is a trivial spelling/plural drift. The company's actual legal name — Mettler-Toledo (Changzhou) Precision Instruments Ltd. is the actual Chinese entity. The difference is just a plural "s", which is spelling drift → same-entity. Best value: register's form since it's the canonical form? The rules say spelling drift = same-entity. Best value: which one? Rules specify best_value only for document-noise (from register) and different-entity (document's). For same-entity, presumably the register's canonical form (like number/year rule says register canonical). So best_value = register value.

Verdict: same-entity, best_value: "Mettler-Toledo (Changzhou) Precision Instruments Ltd."
